{{Current events|year=2020|month=01|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present)]], [[2019–2020 Persian Gulf crisis]], [[American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–present)]], Aftermath of the [[Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad]], [[2020 Baghdad International Airport airstrike]]
**Militants fire rockets at [[Iraq|Iraqi]] bases supporting [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. personnel]], nearly hitting the [[Embassy of the United States, Baghdad|U.S. Embassy in Baghdad]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/7c49646a-2f28-11ea-9703-eea0cae3f0de  (FT)]
**U.S. president [[Donald Trump]] vows to target 52 sites significant to Iranians and Iranian culture if Iran "strikes any Americans or American assets." [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/01/04/trump-iran-targets-soleimani-detah-093758 (Politico)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/rockets-target-baghdad-green-zone-base-housing-troops-200104175916421.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**A [[roadside bomb]] strikes a bus in [[Toeni Department]] of [[Burkina Faso]], killing fourteen people, including students on their way to school. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50993439 (BBC)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**An airstrike at a [[military academy]] in [[Tripoli]], [[Libya]], kills at least 28 cadets and wounds dozens more, according to the [[Government of National Accord]]. The BBC cites reports saying the attack could be attributed to the [[Libyan National Army]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-50996450 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*Tens of thousands of mourners, among them [[Prime Minister of Iraq|Iraqi prime minister]] [[Adil Abdul-Mahdi]], attend a funeral procession in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], for those [[2020 Baghdad International Airport airstrike|killed in a United States airstrike]]—among them [[Qasem Soleimani]], the head of [[Iran]]'s [[Quds Force]] and at least five others. The bodies are then brought to [[Karbala]] and [[Najaf]], where [[Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis]] and the other Iraqis killed are to be buried. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/04/middleeast/qasem-soleimani-airstrike-saturday/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-airstrike/us-led-coalition-did-not-conduct-air-strike-near-taji-iraq-camp-spokesman-idUSKBN1Z3065 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Nicolás Maduro]] government announces that Venezuela will sell some of its oil and gold to fund its [[Petro (cryptocurrency)|petro]] [[cryptocurrency]]. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/venezuela-sell-oil-gold-petro-104336950.html (Yahoo Finance)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019–20 Australian bushfire season]]
**Two people are confirmed dead from [[bushfire]]s on [[Kangaroo Island]] in [[South Australia]]. [https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/climate-change/all-hell-is-breaking-loose-massive-fire-threatens-all-of-kangaroo-island/news-story/6fbad55c97d304431786471fa20c88dd (News.com.au)]
**New records for the highest recorded temperature are set in Greater [[Sydney]] ({{convert|48.9|C|F}} at [[Penrith, New South Wales|Penrith]]) and [[Canberra]] ({{convert|44|C|F}}). [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/jan/04/australian-weather-canberra-and-penrith-smash-temperature-records-that-stood-for-80-years (''The Guardian'')]
*Four people are killed when a [[Mooney M20]] plane crashes shortly after [[takeoff]] near the island of [[Lifou]], [[New Caledonia]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/406711/four-die-in-new-caledonia-plane-crash (RNZ)]
*A plane crashes near [[Santa Clarita, California]], killing the pilot. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/04/us/california-plane-crash-trnd/ (CNN)]
